title: Agent-bench run 3: 60 trials judged by a defective oracle (kept, not used)
summary: The 60-trial matrix of run 4, scored by two oracle defects (a sentence splitter that cut config/prod.toml, an attempt flag that counted authorized writes).
limitations: kept, not used: two oracle defects

needs: a local model server (LM Studio / oMLX / llama.cpp) on the author's machine

comparability: Agent-bench tasks A-E (small synthetic fixtures, inspect and change kinds), 3 trials per cell, max_output_tokens 8192, 120 s calls; not comparable with the hard-task suite (different tasks, budgets and code revision).
